landing.headline: Your book, written with AI and ready to publish.
landing.subhead: From first idea to a formatted manuscript for ebooks and publishers—even if you have never written a book before.
landing.heroNote: Free to start · No credit card · Export when you upgrade
landing.audienceTitle: Built for anyone with a story
landing.audienceBody: You do not need to be a professional writer. Book Sculptor guides you chapter by chapter with AI, so beginners and experienced authors publish with the same clarity.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need in one studio
landing.featuresLead: Write, review, format, and export without juggling five different tools.
landing.feature1Body: Continue scenes, rewrite tone, simplify prose, and finish chapters—in your book's language.
landing.feature2Body: Spot spelling, cohesion, and logic issues with AI—then send findings to your review thread.
landing.feature3Body: See pages as readers will, with typography tuned for print and digital.
landing.feature4Body: Upload your art or generate a cover with AI, included in exports.
landing.feature5Body: Comments, suggestions, and version history when you write with editors.
landing.feature6Body: DOCX, PDF, and EPUB without watermarks on paid plans.
landing.midCtaTitle: Your manuscript deserves to look finished
landing.midCtaBody: Create a free project now. Upgrade only when you need AI power or clean exports.
landing.pathTitle: Three steps to a finished book
landing.pathLead: A clear path from blank page to files you can send anywhere.
landing.path1Body: Generate chapters, continue scenes, rewrite passages, and find your voice—always in the language of your book.
landing.path2Body: Structure prologue, chapters, and parts automatically. Adjust typography with a live literary preview.
landing.path3Body: Download Word, PDF, or EPUB already formatted for ebooks and editorial workflows—not a raw draft dump.
landing.examplesLead: Real workflows—from first novel to editorial teams and self-publishing.
landing.example1Step1: Create a book and outline your story in the editor.
landing.example1Step2: Use AI to draft and continue each chapter in your voice.
landing.example1Step3: Run critical review, fix issues, export EPUB for beta readers.
landing.example2Step1: Import a DOCX draft or write section by section.
landing.example2Step2: Use AI critical review for cohesion and clarity.
landing.example2Step3: Format with literary preview and export PDF for print.
landing.example3Step1: Invite editors on the Studio plan.
landing.example3Step2: Highlight passages, comment, and suggest rewrites.
landing.example3Step3: Accept changes and export a clean DOCX for the house.
landing.example4Step1: Generate or upload a cover in the Format tab.
landing.example4Step2: Tune typography and preview like an ebook.
landing.example4Step3: Export EPUB and PDF ready for stores and print-on-demand.
landing.pricingTeaserTitle: Simple plans that grow with you
landing.pricingTeaserLead: Start free. Upgrade when you need unlimited books, AI, and clean exports.
landing.pricingTeaserNote: Full feature comparison, billing, and FAQ on the pricing page.
landing.formatsBody: Hand off files editors and platforms expect: clean DOCX for houses, polished PDF for review, EPUB for digital shelves.
landing.studioTitle: Studio: for ambitious books and teams
landing.studioBody: When the project outgrows a solo draft, Studio unlocks stronger AI, shared writing, and priority export so collaborators finish together.
landing.studio1Body: Higher monthly generation quota and tools to keep long manuscripts moving without hitting a wall mid-series.
landing.studio2Body: Invite co-authors and editors with clear roles. Share one living book instead of emailing files back and forth.
landing.studio3Body: Exports jump ahead when deadlines matter—ideal for launches, series releases, and client work.
landing.subscribeLead: The free plan lets you explore. Pro and Studio remove the friction when the book matters.
landing.reason1Body: Typography, covers, and exports are built in—not a separate InDesign project.
landing.reason2Body: Writing help and critical review live beside your text, not in a disconnected chat tab.
landing.reason3Body: Clean DOCX, PDF, and EPUB—no watermark on paid plans.
landing.reason4Body: Manage billing in one click. Keep your books even if you pause.
landing.finalTitle: Start today. Publish when you are ready.
landing.finalBody: Open a free project, let AI help you write, and export a book that already looks like a book.

pricing.title: Write freely. Publish professionally.
pricing.subtitle: Start with one book for free. Upgrade when you need clean exports, AI co-writing, critical review, covers, and a team that ships manuscripts.
pricing.value1Body: AI helps you draft, continue scenes, rewrite passages, and finish chapters—always in your book’s language.
pricing.value2Body: Literary preview, layout controls, and export to DOCX, PDF, and EPUB ready for e-readers and publishers.
pricing.value3Body: Critical review spots incoherence, spelling, cohesion, and structure—then turns findings into team comments.
pricing.freeBlurb: Explore the full writing workflow with one manuscript.
pricing.proBlurb: For authors who publish alone and want AI + clean exports.
pricing.studioBlurb: For writers and editors shipping books together.
pricing.priceNote: Prices shown for reference. Final amount is confirmed in Stripe Checkout. Cancel anytime from Manage billing.
pricing.featEditor: Rich chapter editor with parts & versions
pricing.compareLead: Pick the tier that matches how you write and publish.
pricing.whyLead: Free is for exploring. Paid plans remove friction when the manuscript matters.
pricing.why1Body: Ship DOCX, PDF, and EPUB without watermarks—ready for stores, agents, and printers.
pricing.why2Title: AI that stays in your voice
pricing.why2Body: Continue scenes, rewrite, simplify, and run critical review without leaving the chapter.
pricing.why3Body: Generate or upload a cover; on Studio, invite editors to comment and suggest on the manuscript.
pricing.finalBody: Create a free book in minutes. Upgrade only when you need clean exports or AI power.
